title: Doctrine 25
style: cinematic post-rock, slow-build, tremolo guitars, mallets, taiko drums in the climax, no vocals or distant choral oohs, 80 bpm building to 120, epic, hopeful resolution, instrumental
lyrics:
[Intro - quiet, single guitar tremolo]

[Section 1 - bass and mallets enter, building patience]

[Section 2 - drums enter, half-time, distant choral oohs]
(ahhh, ahhh, ahhh)
(ahhh, ahhh, ahhh)

[Section 3 - climb, tremolo guitar swells, taiko drums begin]

[Climax - full band, choir, taiko driving]
(ahhh, ahhh, hold the gates)
(ahhh, ahhh, hold the gates)
(ahhh, ahhh, hold the gates)
(hold, hold, hold)

[Resolution - drop to single piano, choir fades]
(ahhh... ahhh... ahhh...)

[Outro - silence and one held note]
